name: Language Arts — Reading Response
subject: Language Arts
desc: Reading comprehension lesson using a mentor text. Students apply inferencing strategies and respond in writing using text evidence.

data.lessonTitle: Deep Reading — Making Inferences and Using Text Evidence
data.achKnowledge: Define inference and identify text evidence that supports a conclusion.
data.achThinking: Apply inferencing strategy to determine unstated meaning in a text.
data.achCommunication: Construct a written response that states a claim and supports it with specific text evidence.
data.achApplication: Connect themes in the text to personal experience or real-world situations.
data.assessDiagnostic: Show an image and ask: "What can you tell about this scene? How do you know?" Establish that inferencing means reading clues to reach a conclusion.
data.assessFormative: Circulate during reading and annotating. Prompt: "What evidence in the text helped you think that?"
data.assessAs: Students self-check written response: Did I state my inference? Did I include two pieces of text evidence?
data.assessOf: Written reading response: state one inference and support with two pieces of evidence from the text.
data.priorLearning: Students can read and comprehend grade-level texts independently. Familiar with concept of main idea and details.
data.differentiation:
IEP/ELL: Pre-highlight key passages. Sentence frame: 'I can infer ___ because the text says ___'
Extension: compare inference to another text or make a text-to-world connection.
data.technology: Digital text displayed on Smartboard for shared reading and annotation.
data.mindsOnDesc: Read aloud a short, intriguing passage without revealing the title. "Without me telling you, what do you think is happening? How do you know?" Introduce: this is inferencing — reading the clues the author leaves.
data.consolidationDesc: Students share their written inference with a partner. Whole-class share: 3–4 students read their response. Class votes: strong evidence or needs more support?
data.extension: Find a second inference in the same text. Write a one-paragraph response with three pieces of evidence.
